# wisp-science v1.18.0 — Subagents

**Hand a focused task to its own conversation, watch it work, and get the result back in the conversation that asked.**

A conversation's agent can now start a **subagent**: a separate conversation for one task, listed under its parent in the sidebar. You can open it and read the live transcript, but only the parent can instruct it. This release also adds `map_items` for running one instruction over many papers, conversation timers, local file uploads in Files, and automatic database backups before an upgrade.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel; compatible installations can update in-app.
- **macOS SwiftUI Preview**: separate signed and notarized DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel, each with a SHA-256 checksum.
- **Windows**: MSI and NSIS installers. Windows release signing is currently disabled, so these installers remain unsigned.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.

Installers will appear in Assets as the platform builds finish. The Windows WinUI 3 preview remains available through native-preview workflow artifacts or a local source build; it does not replace the regular Windows installer.

## Subagent conversations

- The parent's agent gets three tools: `dispatch_subagent` starts a subagent with a self-contained instruction or sends a follow-up to an idle one, `subagent_status` reports progress and the latest answer, and `stop_subagent` cancels a running turn.
- Subagents appear under a **Subagents** heading beneath their parent. Opening one shows the live transcript with a locked composer. Tool approvals still appear in the subagent's own transcript.
- The backend enforces the watch-only rule: messages, queued follow-ups, cut-ins, timers, rewinds and undo that do not come from the parent are refused. A queued researcher follow-up can no longer be cut into a running subagent turn and shape the answer reported to the parent.
- When a subagent turn ends, including when it ends with a question, its result is reviewed with the parent's model and appended to the parent conversation. No polling is needed. The parent is not resumed automatically.
- A subagent has no `ask_user` and cannot start subagents. One dispatched from a WeChat-originated turn keeps that turn's approval floor for mutating tools.
- The parent link survives restart. A turn that was running at shutdown is not resumed.
- WebView rewind and session imports now lock the conversation, closing the remaining gaps in the conversation guard.

Subagents share their dispatch mechanism with the research assistant's `dispatch_to_project`. See [agent delegation](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.18.0/docs/agent-delegation.md#subagent-conversations).

## Batch work: map_items

- `map_items` applies one instruction to many frozen items, each in its own short-lived model context. Screening 100 downloaded papers is one tool call; the main context receives only counts and short lists.
- Rows are written to `.wisp/map-runs/<run_id>/rows.jsonl` and `results.csv`. A run can use host text extraction, an optional schema-checked read-only worker confined to the project root, and an optional reduce over the structured rows.
- With a TypeSafe key, each row can also carry a Jev decision: pass, reject or uncertain, from calibrated probabilities.
- One approval covers a stated cost bound. Resume skips finished items and retries failed ones. Time and token ceilings pause the run instead of truncating it, a circuit breaker stops on a failing service, and Stop pauses.

Available on desktop and CLI. See the [map_items guide](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.18.0/docs/map-items.md) and [tutorial](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-map-items.html).

## Timers, Files and Runs

- `/timer 1h Check progress` repeats a prompt in the current conversation. Each conversation has one timer; a bare `/timer` opens the manager. Before each check, only the previous timer turn is removed from the transcript and model context, and ordinary messages are kept. See [automation](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.18.0/docs/automation.md).
- **Files** accepts local file uploads and native drag-and-drop.
- **Runs** has an "ask about progress" entry that opens the side chat scoped to that Run with a prefilled question.
- The empty conversation screen shows a dismissible usage tip. **Settings → Session → Follow-up interaction** turns tips off for good.
- Automation now lives in the research assistant header instead of the home screen. Returning to the assistant from a notification no longer opens its hidden project.
- The WeChat research assistant supports `/model` to switch models and `/resume` to rerun the last failed request.
- The computer-use skill's Cua Driver is detected in Settings → Local environment, and a bare `cua-driver` MCP connection runs from the saved path.

## Fixes and safety

- Each database is copied to `backups/` in the application data directory before a different app version migrates it. This covers `wisp.sqlite`, `library.sqlite` and every project database, which is copied when first opened. Three copies are kept per database, and a failed copy never blocks startup.
- SSH user names may contain `@`, so gateways that require `user@tenant` logins can be registered and probed. Aliases and host addresses still reject it.
- Windows detached Run scripts are written with a UTF-8 BOM. A non-ASCII project path, such as a Chinese one, no longer breaks the local detached Run under Windows PowerShell 5.1.
- Desktop autopilot offers goal-relevant controls and batches computer-use input.

## Native previews

- SwiftUI Preview gains conversation modes, history and workspace search, scoped options and tool approvals, turn preview and undo, model context inspection, reviewed ZIP import, inline image previews with a shared follow-up queue, and Files previews.
- WinUI 3 Preview improves conversation readability, table artifacts and research workspace parity, and the Windows preview release workflow now builds two variants. Subagent conversations are read-only there too.

Native previews are still not feature-complete. SwiftUI Preview requires macOS 13+, installs alongside the regular app and shares its project data, settings and keyring. It updates by manual download. The regular WebView app and its updater remain available.

# wisp-science v1.18.0 — 子代理

**把一项专门任务交给独立对话，观察它的进展，并在发起任务的对话里收到结果。**

对话中的 Agent 现在可以启动**子代理**：为单个任务建立的独立对话，显示在父对话下方的侧栏中。你可以打开它查看实时记录，但只有父对话能向它下达指令。本版本还新增了对大量文献执行同一条指令的 `map_items`、对话定时器、文件页的本地上传，以及升级前的数据库自动备份。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的 DMG 安装包，签名并公证；兼容版本可在应用内更新。
- **macOS SwiftUI 预览版**：独立的 Apple Silicon 与 Intel DMG 安装包，签名并公证，各附 SHA-256 校验文件。
- **Windows**：MSI 与 NSIS 安装包。目前正式签名仍关闭，安装包暂未签名。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。

各平台构建完成后，安装包会陆续出现在 Assets。Windows WinUI 3 预览版仍通过 native-preview 工作流产物或本地源码构建获取，不替代常规 Windows 安装包。

## 子代理对话

- 父对话的 Agent 获得三个工具：`dispatch_subagent` 用自包含的指令启动子代理，或向空闲的子代理发送后续指令；`subagent_status` 报告进展和最新回答；`stop_subagent` 取消正在运行的一轮。
- 子代理显示在父对话下方的**子代理**标题中。打开后可以看到实时记录，输入框被锁定。工具审批仍然出现在子代理自己的对话里。
- 后端强制执行只读规则：不是来自父对话的消息、排队的后续指令、插入引导、定时器、回退和撤销都会被拒绝。排队的研究者后续消息不会再被插入正在运行的子代理回合，影响回报给父对话的答案。
- 子代理一轮结束后，包括以提问结束时，结果会由父对话的模型审阅，并追加到父对话中，无需轮询。父对话不会因此自动恢复运行。
- 子代理没有 `ask_user`，也不能再启动子代理。由微信发起的回合派发的子代理，沿用该回合对修改类工具的审批下限。
- 父子关联在重启后保留。关闭应用时正在运行的一轮不会自动恢复。
- WebView 的回退和会话导入现在会锁定对话，补上了对话保护中剩余的缺口。

子代理与科研助理的 `dispatch_to_project` 共用同一套派发机制。详见[Agent 委派说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.18.0/docs/agent-delegation.md#subagent-conversations)。

## 批量处理：map_items

- `map_items` 对一组固定条目执行同一条指令，每个条目使用各自的短生命周期模型上下文。筛选 100 篇已下载文献只需一次工具调用，主对话只收到计数和简短列表。
- 结果行写入 `.wisp/map-runs/<run_id>/rows.jsonl` 和 `results.csv`。每个条目可使用宿主文本提取、可选的带结构校验的只读工作器（限定在项目根目录内），以及对结构化行的可选汇总。
- 配置 TypeSafe 密钥后，每一行还可以带有 Jev 判断：通过、拒绝或不确定，依据校准后的概率。
- 一次审批对应一个声明的成本上限。恢复运行会跳过已完成条目并重试失败条目；时间和 token 上限触发时暂停而不是截断；服务持续失败时熔断；停止即暂停。

桌面端和命令行均可使用。详见 [map_items 说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.18.0/docs/map-items.md)与[使用教程](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-map-items.html)。

## 定时器、文件与 Run

- `/timer 1h 当前进展如何` 在当前对话中按间隔重复提示词。每个对话只有一个定时器；单独输入 `/timer` 打开管理面板。每次检查前，只移除上一轮定时器的记录及模型上下文，普通消息保留。详见[自动化说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.18.0/docs/automation.md)。
- **文件**页支持本地文件上传和原生拖放。
- **Run** 新增“询问进展”入口，打开限定在该 Run 的侧边对话，并预填进展问题。
- 空白对话页会显示可关闭的使用提示。**设置 → 会话 → 后续交互**可永久关闭。
- 自动化入口从首页移到科研助理页眉。从通知返回助理时，不再打开它隐藏的项目。
- 微信科研助理支持用 `/model` 切换模型、用 `/resume` 重新执行上一次失败的请求。
- 设置 → 本地环境会检测 computer-use 技能使用的 Cua Driver，裸 `cua-driver` MCP 连接会从已保存的路径启动。

## 修复与安全

- 当另一个应用版本即将迁移某个数据库时，会先把它复制到应用数据目录的 `backups/`。涵盖 `wisp.sqlite`、`library.sqlite` 以及每个项目数据库（项目在首次打开时复制）。每个数据库保留三份，复制失败不会阻止启动。
- SSH 用户名允许包含 `@`，要求 `user@tenant` 登录的网关现在可以注册和探测。别名和主机地址仍然拒绝 `@`。
- Windows 分离式 Run 脚本现在使用带 BOM 的 UTF-8 写入。在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 下，含非 ASCII 字符（如中文）的项目路径不再导致本地分离式 Run 启动失败。
- 桌面自动驾驶提供与目标相关的控件，并合并批量的电脑操作输入。

## 原生预览版

- SwiftUI 预览版新增对话模式、历史与工作区搜索、分范围的选项和工具审批、回合预览与撤销、模型上下文检查、已审阅的 ZIP 导入、内联图片预览与共享的后续消息队列，以及文件预览。
- WinUI 3 预览版改进对话阅读、表格产物和研究工作区一致性，Windows 预览版发布工作流现在构建两个变体。子代理对话在那里同样只读。

原生预览版尚未完全覆盖常规版本功能。SwiftUI 预览版要求 macOS 13+，与常规应用并存，共用项目数据、设置和密钥环，通过手动下载更新。常规 WebView 应用及其更新器仍可使用。
